scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && ALLOW_MISSING_TURNSTILE=1 npm run test && ALLOW_MISSING_TURNSTILE=1 npm run build && npm run check-public
scripts.questions: wrangler d1 execute plamen-site --remote --command "SELECT ts, question FROM questions ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100"
scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute plamen-site --remote --command "SELECT ts, vote, question, answer FROM feedback ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.clicks: wrangler d1 execute plamen-site --remote --command "SELECT link, SUM(count) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN day >= date('now', '-6 days') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS last_7_days FROM clicks GROUP BY link ORDER BY total DESC"
